title: Walking tour of old city
text: Wonderful tour of the old city in Granada. I recommend a self guided tour to go at your own pace and stop and enjoy the environment. You could spend all day doing this. The instructions are clear and the narrator is knowledgeable
author: Lynette7711

title: Great Self Guided Tour
text: Excellent details and very good directions. We really enjoyed it and learned a lot about Granada. Thank you.
author: joan_h
